item.title: Implement spec-compliant token bucket rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py; it currently contains stubs. Follow SPEC.md exactly, including all error cases and edge cases. Keep the implementation dependency-free (standard library only). The basic tests in test_ratelimit.py are not exhaustive, so cover the specified behavior beyond those basics as needed. Commit the completed work. Acceptance criteria: TokenBucket validation, full initial state, continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, atomic try_acquire behavior, available and non-consuming wait_time, validation for invalid n, and backwards-clock handling that freezes until time advances past the latest observed timestamp; KeyedLimiter validation, independent buckets per hashable key, LRU eviction on both try_acquire and wait_time, fresh-full buckets after eviction, and correct len(). Use only the injected clock for time.

pr.body: Implemented TokenBucket with full initial capacity, continuous refill capped at capacity, non-consuming wait_time, request validation, and a latest-observed timestamp that prevents refill during backward-clock movement. Implemented KeyedLimiter with independent per-key buckets, LRU tracking on both operations, eviction to fresh full buckets, parameter validation, and len(). Added deterministic fake-clock tests for specified edge cases. Checks: python -B -m unittest -v (8 passed); git diff --check (passed). Assumption: capacity and token requests may be fractional because the spec permits continuous fractional token availability and does not require integer-only requests.
